name: custtoolset_pillar2_extractor
description: Extracts SuiteScript performance data from the script execution logs to identify governance limit risks, latency, and concurrency bottlenecks.

analysisType.description: The specific performance metric to analyze. Use 'usage_consumption' for governance limits, 'execution_time' for slow scripts, or 'concurrency' for scheduling and RESTlet thread collisions.

returns.description: A structured JSON payload containing aggregated SuiteScript execution metrics.
